records.context: With ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (item 980) no AI is asked: every UniProt GO term and keyword of the screening experiment's genes, and every CORUM complex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) and Reactome pathway (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), is tested in each cluster by a one-sided hypergeometric test against all the screening experiment's genes, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the cluster's terms. The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screening experiment's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. The same tables are written, plus ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; the reference files are copied with their checksum and date so a rerun works offline.

The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screen's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. records.translation: Com ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (item 980), nenhuma IA é consultada: cada termo UniProt GO e cada palavra-chave dos genes da triagem, e cada complexo CORUM (``ops_voyager3_corum``) e cada via Reactome (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), é testado em cada cluster por um teste hipergeométrico unilateral contra todos os genes da triagem, com FDR de Benjamini-Hochberg entre os termos do cluster. O melhor termo com FDR de no máximo ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, com pelo menos 3 genes do cluster e o dobro da fração da triagem, nomeia o papel; a fração de genes do cluster que o têm dá as mesmas palavras de confiança, e nos clusters high e medium os genes sem ele são os candidatos. As mesmas tabelas são gravadas, mais ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; os arquivos de referência são copiados com sua soma de verificação e data, para que uma nova execução funcione offline.
